hypothesis: Real options order-flow toxicity predicts subsequent realized volatility, and a signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle measured with the correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L is tradable for the BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized data.

protocol.title: Real options order-flow toxicity -> signal-timed delta-hedged ATM straddle with correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L on the BTC/ETH perpetual
protocol.supersedes: EVAL-61 (P&L artifact: un-normalized dollar P&L treated as returns -> max-DD=1.0 -> false NO-GO; EVAL-62 uses EVAL-57 correct mark-path ret=(gross-cost)/S)

tox_detail.tox: (call_notional - put_notional)/(call_notional + put_notional) from real Deribit option trades per bar (EVAL-61 helper, reused)
tox_detail.imbalance: (aggressive_buy_amt - aggressive_sell_amt)/total_amt (signed aggressor variant, EVAL-61 helper, reused)

protocol.position: side_k = sign(tox_z_k); exposure_k = clip(|tox_z_k|, 0, size_cap); causal decision at bar k; delta-hedged in the perp
protocol.straddle: front-expiry common strike nearest spot, both legs priced from real marks (EVAL-57 _pick_straddle_quotes/_iv_and_greeks, reused)
protocol.pnl_per_bar: dOption_k = side_k*exposure_k*(mark_{k+1}-mark_k)*S_k; gross_k = dOption_k + hedge_k*dS_k; ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge_fee_bps on |Δhedge|*S; half real 2-leg spread at entry/exit; full spread on side flip (identical to EVAL-57)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
